description: This file defines the PersonGrain class, an Orleans grain implementing event sourcing for person entities, including methods for registration, marriage, name changes, and internal state testing.

classes.name: PersonGrain
classes.description: An Orleans event-sourced grain managing person state with methods for registration, marriage, name changes, and internal testing.

methods.name: RegisterBirth
methods.description: Registers a person's birth if not already registered.

methods.name: Marry
methods.description: Handles the marriage process with another person grain, raising appropriate events.

methods.name: ChangeLastName
methods.description: Changes the person's last name, raising an event without immediate confirmation.

methods.name: ConfirmChanges
methods.description: Confirms all pending events, updating the state.

methods.name: GetTentativePersonalAttributes
methods.description: Returns the person's attributes in a tentative state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version number.

methods.name: GetTentativeVersion
methods.description: Returns the current tentative version number.

methods.name: RunTentativeConfirmedStateTest
methods.description: A unit test method to verify tentative and confirmed state synchronization.
